mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 1.0% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase above 5.0% signals labor market deterioration, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) by more than 0.5% in one month signals broad economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and HOUST both decline > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST decline by >0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-shock recovery phase, a low inflation rate (CPIAUCSL monthly change < 0.1%) signals deflationary concerns that prompt aggressive monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL monthly change is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained housing starts level above 1600 thousand units signals strong consumer demand for residential construction, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1600 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: When the quarterly GDP growth rate (annualized) falls below 0.5%, it indicates severe economic weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 quarterly growth rate (annualized) is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% in one month signals weak consumer demand combined with monetary easing, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and FEDFUNDS both decline > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: weak consumer demand with monetary easing
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and FEDFUNDS decline by >0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly payroll employment decline exceeding 500,000 persons signals a severe labor market shock, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS monthly change is below -500,000.
